intro.title: Design Auth Flow
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple authentication flow for a Vue application, allowing users to log in and log out. You will learn how to manage user authentication state using Vue's reactive data and computed properties. The main technologies involved are Vue components, reactive state, and event handling with methods. By the end, you'll have a functional login form that updates the UI based on the user's authentication status.
intro.usecase: Authentication flows are fundamental to nearly every modern web application that requires user accounts. You'll implement these patterns in e-commerce checkout processes, banking portals that verify identity before granting access, and social media platforms that manage login sessions. As a Vue developer, you'll build secure login forms, registration pages, and protected dashboard routes that redirect unauthenticated users. This lesson teaches you to structure these critical user flows with proper state management and navigation guards.
